orbit_velocity_identity.description: int_0^R mu [d/dr<|b|^2> + 2(x+y)<|b|^2>] dr = mu(R)<|b|^2>(R) + int 2y mu <|b|^2> dr

early_positive_production.description: int_0^{0.5} mu * Phi dr for the center model
early_positive_production.note: From the universal K''(0)>=72, so early production is approximately 6.33

required_negative_production_rate.description: Minimum -C such that late negative production overcomes early positive + 12
required_negative_production_rate.interpretation: Phi must average at least this negative over the late window

mu_effective_radius.note: mu = e^{-3r^2} halves at r ≈ 0.48; contributions beyond r=1 are exponentially small

sign_structure.Phi_covar: INDEFINITE (can be negative through spatial anti-correlation)
sign_structure.Phi_force: bounded by C*delta*(B + H) per unit radius

divergence_analysis.bounded_geometry_consequence: Under bounded <|b|^2> and <h^2>, the mu-weighted positive contributions exceed 12 + early_positive > 18, while the negative terms are bounded per unit effective radius. A K-drop from 12 to 6 requires either (a) large orbit-map velocity <|b|^2> >> 1 to create negative covariance, or (b) large circle curvature <h^2> >> 1 for tension coupling.
divergence_analysis.weyl_consequence: Individual smooth connectors may have Weyl curvature of order max(<|b|^2>, <h^2>, K) >> 1. For a family with delta->0, the geometric amplitude must remain >= O(1), so forcing amplification scales as delta * (geometric amplitude) * R_eff.
